items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the fact that I hired him for my sextet certainly shows that I must have appreciated what he was doing.

ctx.x: In 1941 you pared this big band down to a sextet, and that’s the one that included Dizzy Gillespie.
Yes, that’s right, at Kelly’s Stables [phonetic].

items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: He'd been with Cab Calloway, and I liked what he was doing, and I asked him if he would join me

ctx.x: Actually, I think Jimmy Hamilton played with me at the Famous Door rather than Kelly Stables. Yes.
Right. And then, of course, we remember that Dizzie Gillespie joined you at the famous Door, right?
That's right ... in a sextet I had.
